$comment: Version 1. One case per file, named <id>.json. A case is a review case (no kind, or kind review) or a plan case (kind plan). loadCatalog in catalog.ts also checks what a schema cannot: unique ids, file names, no sealed case in the repo tree, and no decoy whose audit found a defect.
title: Review replay case
description: A historical defect a gstack reviewer role caught or missed (a review case), or a flaw a plan review should catch (a plan case), with the answer key and its provenance.

review_case.description: A historical defect a gstack reviewer role caught or missed, with the range to replay, the answer key, its decoys and its provenance.

kind.description: Optional: a case with no kind is a review case.

id.description: Unique across the catalog; also the file name without .json.

visibility.description: sealed cases live only in the sealed store, never in this repo.

pr.description: The PR whose review the case replays.

reviewed_head.description: The head the historical reviewer read.

merge_base.description: The PR's merge base or fork point at that head.

diff_range.description: The range the replayed reviewer reads: git diff from..to.

roles.description: The reviewer roles the case replays. A specialist names its checklist, gstack's review/specialists/<checklist>.md.

defect.description: The answer key. A catch names this file and this defect.

severity.description: Scored apart from detection. deserved uses gstack's floor: CRITICAL fails a test, breaks production, or loses data or secrets. null means the evidence does not settle it, and basis says why.

decoys.description: The fix commit on the same range, plus clean PRs. A decoy is scorable as clean only when its audit's verdict is clean.

audit.description: null: nobody has audited it, so it is never scored as clean. holds-defect: it is not a decoy; make it a defect case.

later_fix.description: A later commit or PR that fixed something in the decoy's code, or null when the search found none.

receipt.description: Where the case came from and the lines that establish it.

answer_key_audit.description: null until U14 audits the answer key.

shelf_life.description: A short-shelf-life case counts only for models released before the fix PR first appeared.

plan_case.description: A plan flaw a plan review should catch. The unit is a small repository whose head commit adds plan.md; the answer key names the flaw's cause and the plan section it sits under. A sealed panel keeps its cases in the sealed store, never in this repo.

id.description: Unique across the catalog; also the file name without .json.

visibility.description: sealed cases live only in the sealed store, never in this repo.

repo.description: The panel repository that holds the unit.

pr.description: The unit's number in the panel repository.

reviewed_head.description: The unit head: the commit that adds plan.md.

merge_base.description: The unit base: the commit before plan.md, holding context/ and any src/.

plan.description: What the plan is and where the flaw came from.

digest.description: sha256 of plan.md at reviewed_head. Judging reads the plan as it was before any session.

stratum.description: seeded and real-neutral feed the headline, each also read alone; home-field is reported alone; decoy feeds only the false-alarm reading; pilot is never scored.

source.description: The taxonomy that seeded the flaw, or the public post a real-neutral flaw restates. Recall is reported per source.

plan_type.description: The panel balances these, and recall is read by the review mode each tends to select.

flaw_class.description: bait: a decoy's choice that its context justifies and a careless reviewer may flag. A bait's deserved severity is INFORMATIONAL.

defect.description: The answer key. A catch names the same cause in the same plan section; the line may move.

section.description: The stable section identity: the plan heading the flaw sits under, as written.

cause.description: What is wrong, and why it changes what gets built.

severity.description: deserved CRITICAL counts toward must-fix recall, INFORMATIONAL (a decoy's bait) toward false alarms, null toward detection only.
